TESTVILLE, Fla. — A man stole a farm tractor and led Mockingbird County Sheriff's Office deputies on a slow-speed chase Wednesday night before driving it into a pond, deputies said.

Deputies identified the driver as Grady Wayne Pruitt, 41, of Testville. He was arrested and charged with grand theft and fleeing to elude, according to the sheriff's office.

The sheriff's office released body camera footage on Thursday showing deputies wading into the pond to pull Pruitt from the cab of the tractor.
